resources.string: While Samsung Internet is on screen, Edge Rewire covers the left and right screen edges with thin invisible strips. Swiping in from the left goes back one page and does nothing at the first page instead of closing the browser; swiping in from the right goes forward. To decide, it reads the state of the browser\'s own Back and Forward toolbar buttons. It reads nothing else, stores nothing, and sends nothing off the device. Outside the browser the strips are removed and system navigation is untouched. This is an engineering experiment, not an assistive technology.
